map.因为格式化会取运行环境的默认 locale：日期分隔符、千分位符号、小数点、一周: Because formatting picks up the default locale of the runtime environment: date separators, thousands separators, decimal points and the first day of the week can all differ. The safer approach is to specify the locale explicitly and to cover the main target regions in your tests.
